FUZZROCIOUS Pedals – Ram the Manparts – tag on every page of your site. --> Pedalboard Photo Contest! 2 1,352 More Rattlesnake Cable Company / Heather Brown Electronicals Combined Give Away 838 More Guest Post â€“ Revisiting the Boss GT-8 and Line 6 POD X3 Live by Dean Hailstone 1,419 More Pedal Labels are BACK! 2,469 More About Contact Guest Posting Pedal Deals Pedal Line Friday Home 2013 November FUZZROCIOUS Pedals – Ram the Manparts FUZZROCIOUS Pedals – Ram the Manparts I like Fuzzrocious Pedals . We did a give away a little while back that was awesome. Shortly after that, I started seeing one of my favorite bands – Foals using them as well. Then recently, I just posted about a rig rundown of Russian Circles, and again, Fuzzrocious was in the picture. These guys are definitely getting their pedals out there, and some choice musicians are getting their hands on them – which is a great sign of something awesome in the box. I mentioned Russian – Brian Cook (bass) uses one, among others Fuzzrocious pedals ( you can read more here ). He mentioned that the name of Ram the Manparts was possibly in reference to his older band Botch, where they had the song – Man the Ramparts. What started me on this whole tangent was the following demo by Dan Briggs of the band ORBS: That sound is cool. Tough is a way I would like to describe it, but I wanted something a little more detailed in regards to a demo and I found this by Greg’s Guitar Lessons : As you can see.. some interesting tones from this unit. If you’re interested in one for yourself (It’s on my short list of want-to-buy), you can purchase it at Amazon.com for $165.00 , but definitely checkout Fuzzrocious Pedals on line for their other pedals.
